title: implement.json / implement.<repo>.json
description: What the implementer did in one repo: steps done of the plan's total, the commits, the gate results it saw, the deviations from the plan, and where it stopped.

commits.description: One commit per entry: the sha, with its subject if you like.

gates.description: Gate name → result (PASS, FAIL, SKIP …). The gate cache (gates.mjs) is the authority; this records what the implementer saw.

stopped.description: null while it ran to the end; { step, question } when it stopped for the person.

complexity.description: The rating the work experienced; "higher" when it proved harder than the highest rating.
